unresolved.place: M0278, horizontal stroke above and to the right of the subscript 5
unresolved.issue: The visible stroke may be a separate raised dash or the detached top bar of the handwritten 5. Its attachment cannot be decided from the single crop; it is preserved with C’s doubt.

notes.text: The large letter grid, six repeated listing rows and two footer lines are pale blue, laterally reversed impressions showing through the sheet. They are excluded from the front-side transcription. The affected C doubts are removed as source-status errors, without guessing the individual reverse-side characters.

The front heading reads M with subscript 0,5. The horizontal stroke above the right side of 5 remains unresolved between a detached digit-top stroke and a following raised dash. No mathematical interpretation has been used to remove it.
The bottom number is plainly 28. Its hand and origin remain unassigned, so it is retained as a margin foliation rather than attributed as an authorial page number.
The date strings in the reversed footer are not treated as dates of the handwritten front annotation. No mathematical claim is asserted on this front and no mathematical check was performed.
